import ctypes
import hashlib
import binascii

def task_func(filepath):
    dll = ctypes.CDLL(filepath)
    with open(filepath, "rb") as file_obj:
        data = file_obj.read()

    md5_hex = binascii.hexlify(hashlib.md5(data).digest()).decode("ascii")
    sha256_hex = binascii.hexlify(hashlib.sha256(data).digest()).decode("ascii")

    print(md5_hex)
    print(sha256_hex)

    dll_name = getattr(dll, "_name", filepath)
    return dll_name.rsplit("\\", 1)[-1].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
